5. **Qualitative Adjustment**: Recent prices are accelerating upward (3 consecutive gains), net demand positive → reduce short size by 15% to ~0.53 shares.

decision_payload.reasoning: Overvalued by ~5.3% but positive momentum reduces short size by 15%
